strengths: excellent resistance in many seawater and aqueous environments
strong resistance to many oxidising chemical environments
controls: reducing acids can be more aggressive
galvanic coupling to dissimilar metals requires assessment
surface contamination and deposits can affect local corrosion behaviour
temperature and chemistry must be specified
galvanic: Titanium can drive galvanic current against less noble metals; electrical isolation or compatible material pairing may be required.
design_rule: Corrosion resistance is environment-specific and must not be represented as an unconditional material property.
